Create a production game sprite atlas, transparent background, exactly FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS, sixteen equal square cells on a 2048x2048 canvas. One majestic male lion with tawny golden fur and dark brown mane, stylized detailed painterly fantasy RPG art. Same lion identity and perspective in every cell, looking right. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: each complete lion occupies ONLY the central 60 percent of EACH cell's width and height. Every cell has a huge transparent margin, at least 20 percent empty space on EVERY side. All paws, mane and curved tail MUST stay inside its own cell. Curl ALL tails tightly near the hind legs, never horizontal extending tails. No outstretched limbs outside bounds. There must be four completely empty straight horizontal/vertical gutters separating rows/columns. Absolutely NO contact or overlap between neighboring lions. Make every lion uniformly much smaller than typical sprite sheets: sixteen tiny full-body separated lions. Grounded stances only, NO flying/pounce/leap. Row1: resting ready, head lift, breathing ready, crouch ready. Row2: one raised forepaw close to chest, compact mouth-open bite stance, compact short forward attack with bent forepaw, compact standing roar. Row3: alert, short roar, block crouch, compact flinch. Row4: low crouch, curled sleeping/rest pose, victory roar, calm ready. Transparent cutouts, no background, no decorative strokes, no glows, no color fringe, no text, no cell borders. Priority is isolated full-body sprites with generous gutters, rather than dramatic extended action. Maintain an exact equal 4x4 grid.
assets.notes: Regenerated with compact grounded poses and generous per-cell margins after QA found cross-cell paws/tails. Actual atlas 1254×1254; 16 equal normalized cells. No manual pixel edits.
